key_insight: A harder, expanded Polish medical exam benchmark showed that apparent LLM performance can drop sharply when MCQA-specific shortcuts and biases are reduced.
clinical_relevance: This suggests current multiple-choice scores may overstate how well medical LLMs would perform on clinically realistic reasoning tasks.
method: Added 15,000+ questions plus two new domains
Introduced four structural changes to reduce multiple-choice artifacts
Evaluated 21 LLMs on English and Polish medical exams
evidence_signal: In the tougher evaluation setup, the top model (Qwen3.5-122B) fell by 28.4 points on English exams and 31 points on Polish exams, indicating strong sensitivity to benchmark design.
watch_item: Public benchmark results may still not fully capture real-world clinical performance, so model use should not rely on MCQA alone.
paper_title: Reassessing High-Performing LLMs on Polish Medical Exams: True Competence or Bias-Driven Performance?
